name: SLR-Bench-Portuguese
description:
🧠 SLR-Bench-Portuguese: Scalable Logical Reasoning Benchmark (Portuguese Edition)
	





	
		
	
	
		SLR-Bench Versions:
	








SLR-Bench-Portuguese is the Portuguese-language pendant of the original SLR-Bench dataset.
It follows the same symbolic structure, evaluation framework, and curriculum as the English version but provides all natural-language task prompts translated into Portuguese.
This enables systematic evaluation and training of Large Language Models (LLMs) in logical… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ahmad21omar/SLR-Bench-Portuguese.
reputation: A useful resource for assessing logical and symbolic reasoning in Portuguese LLMs, but has more limited adoption compared to English-language reasoning benchmarks.
